title: Semantic Checkpoint Suite for Embedding Reranker Regression and Load Validation
creator: Ava Patel
description:
Goal: build a reproducible offline validation pipeline ("Checkpoint Suite") that detects semantic regressions, measures latency/cost tradeoffs for embedding + rerank flows, and provides drift alerts and canary signals before model rollouts.

Scope:
- Curate a stable set of 'semantic checkpoints' (50k queries, ~5k high-quality golden queries with human judgments) spanning search, QA rerank, and semantic similarity tasks.
- Implement an offline runner that computes a standard metric pack: MRR@10, Recall@1/5/10, NDCG@10, MAP, cosine similarity distribution summaries, embedding calibration (expected similarity vs. human relevance).
- Add synthetic perturbation probes (typo, paraphrase, truncation, adversarial token insertions) to stress-test reranker robustness.
- Monitor distributional drift nightly using statistical tests (KL divergence on similarity histograms, PSI on nearest-neighbor ranks) and surface alerts when thresholds are crossed.
- Integrate signals into Console dashboards + Slack runbook. Provide canary split plan to test candidate model variants on 5% of production traffic after offline pass.

Dataset curation and labeling:
- Golden queries will be sampled from existing enterprise workloads (anonymized and approved by privacy) and augmented by targeted edge-case selection from recent incidents.
- Labeling guidelines: 3-annotator majority with adjudication for disagreement >20%. Labels on a 3-level scale: Relevant / Maybe / Not Relevant. Store labels in S3 under s3://redwood-embed-gold/checkpoints/2025-02/ with immutability tag.

Acceptance criteria:
- Nightly runner completes end-to-end on sampled corpus within 2 hours at scale sample size (50k queries).
- Regression detection alert fires when MRR@10 drops by >2.5% absolute or PSI >0.12 for top-50 rank distribution.
- Console dashboard shows per-model historical trend for each metric with 90-day retention.
- Canary flow can be enabled via rollout config to route 5% traffic to candidate reranker variant.

Monitoring & Alerts:
- Primary detectors: absolute metric deltas (MRR/Recall/NDCG), distribution tests (KL/PSI), nearest-neighbor stability (median rank shift).
- Alert destinations: #infra-ai-alerts Slack channel, Console anomaly panel, on-call pager if high-severity (customer-impact = high).
- Initial thresholds: MRR drop > 2.5% OR PSI > 0.12 => Pager if accompanied by latency degradation > 15ms p50. Otherwise Slack alert for triage.

Telemetry & Instrumentation:
- Export per-checkpoint metrics to Prometheus/Datadog with tags: model, quantization_profile, dataset_checkpoint, runner_version.
- Add a lightweight pairwise sample upload to Console for failing checkpoints to enable triage (first 500 failures).

Cost/Perf tradeoffs:
- Run experiments measuring embedding dimensionality, quantization level (int8/q4), and batching window size on end-to-end reranker latency. Capture tokens-per-second, p50/p95 latency, and cost-per-query.
- Provide recommended default quantization profiles for customer tiers (hosted vs dedicated).

Privacy & Compliance:
- Ensure query golden set is PII-scrubbed. All human labels processed under existing data processing agreement. Request privacy sign-off from Legal before using any customer-derived queries.

Rollout plan:
- Phase 1 (this ticket): curator + offline runner + CI job + dashboard pieces.
- Phase 2: drift alerting, canary rollout control, runbook + on-call playbook.
- Phase 3: automated rollback triggers and SLA integration.

Dependencies: labeling budget, telemetry retention quotas, and small infra quota increase for nightly sample runs.
